function: Device scheduling for over-the-air (AirComp) federated learning in a UAV swarm (area 7); links use a scalar channel gain, single antenna at both ends, no RIS (p. 5).
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Reason system: the work is of area 7 (probabilistic device scheduling with channel-inversion power control for AirComp federated learning, pp. 5, 7), and every link is single-antenna with no RIS. p. 5 models the channel as the scalar gain "hn,t = Hn(t)10^-ln,t/10" and the received signal as "yt = sum hn,t Pn,t gn,t + zt"; no antenna count appears in the text, in Table II (p. 3) or in Table III (p. 8), both read from the page images. Earlier codes do not apply: federated learning over the air passes no_learning, the aggregation is analog AirComp (p. 5), and the scheduling is not learned. The links are UAV-to-UAV aerial links, but the area is 7 (it has priority over 6, and the learned element is the CNN trained by federated learning, not a resource or power controller), so I did not apply the NTN exemption; reviewer to confirm, since reading that exemption as covering any aerial-link work would make this an include in area 7.
